description: Source code for the DefaultQueryManager class implementing IQueryManager, managing query lifecycle including creation, deletion, execution, listing, and updating within OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: DefaultQueryManager
classes.description: Sealed class implementing IQueryManager, responsible for managing queries including creation, deletion, execution, listing, and updating within OrchardCore.

methods.name: DeleteQueryAsync
methods.description: Deletes queries by names, invoking handlers for deleting and post-deletion events.

methods.name: ExecuteQueryAsync
methods.description: Executes a given query using the specified query source.

methods.name: GetIdentifierAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the queries document.

methods.name: GetQueryAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a query by name, loading its details.

methods.name: ListQueriesAsync
methods.description: Lists all queries, optionally filtered by context.

methods.name: NewAsync
methods.description: Creates a new query with specified source and data, invoking initialization handlers.

methods.name: PageQueriesAsync
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of queries based on page number and size.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing query with new data, possibly changing its source.

methods.name: SaveAsync
methods.description: Saves multiple queries to the document.

methods.name: LocateQueriesAsync
methods.description: Locates queries based on context filters.

methods.name: UpdateBaseProperties
methods.description: Updates core properties of a query from JSON data.
